rules.title: LA RSO/JCO no-fault eviction relocation assistance and Declaration of Intent to Evict
rules.requirement: For no-fault evictions from units covered by the RSO or JCO, landlords must pay relocation assistance and file a Declaration of Intent to Evict with LAHD before serving a termination notice. A copy of the notice must be filed with LAHD within 3 days of service, and payment must be made available within 15 days of service.
rules.key_value: Relocation $11,000-$27,400 per unit (7/1/2026-6/30/2027); payment within 15 days
rules.quoted_span: All tenant not- at-fault evictions require payment of relocation assistance and the filing of a Declaration of Intent to Evict form with the Los Angeles Housing Department (LAHD)
rules.effective_date_note: Underlying ordinance start date not stated; current relocation amounts effective 2026-07-01 and increase each July 1.

unverifiable_exemptions: single-family dwellings owned by natural persons (reduced to one month's rent)
Mom and Pop owner/family occupancy reduced payment

rules.coverage_conditions: Units covered by the RSO or JCO.
rules.exemptions: Resident manager replaced by another resident manager; natural-disaster hazardous conditions; reduced amounts for Mom and Pop properties and natural-person single-family dwellings.
rules.penalty: Failure to file the Landlord Declaration makes the eviction a violation of the RSO or JCO; tenant may raise non-payment as an affirmative defense.

rules.title: LA Resident Protections Ordinance - relocation and occupant protections for demolition for new construction
rules.requirement: Owners demolishing Protected Units for new construction must pay enhanced relocation to lower-income households, under one of three options. Tenants may remain until 6 months before construction starts and have return and first-refusal rights.
rules.quoted_span: Failure to comply with the RPO may result in financial penalties starting at $250,000 per displaced unit and withholding of LAHD permit clearances.
rules.effective_date_note: Bulletin states the RPO is effective 2/11/2025 under Ordinances #188481 and #188482.

unverifiable_exemptions: Protected Unit status (covenant, rent control, lower-income occupancy in past 5 years, Ellis withdrawal within 10 years)

rules.coverage_conditions: Only Protected Units demolished for new construction; all RSO units are Protected Units.
rules.penalty: Financial penalties starting at $250,000 per displaced unit and withholding of LAHD permit clearances.

parsed.doc_summary: LAHD relocation assistance bulletins A and B (rev. 7/1/2026) covering no-fault evictions under the RSO and JCO, relocation amounts, filing and payment timing, and the Resident Protections Ordinance for demolition for new construction.
